thread:
customer_acme: Hey team, we've got a batch of streaming calls that cut off mid-response and our billing shows them as 5xx. request_id=rl-03a2f4, happened ~2024-05-12T14:23:10Z. Using SDK v0.9.2 with chunked transfer.

amanda_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact curl/SDK snippet and whether you see any client-side socket errors? Also which model + region? :sad_face:

customer_acme: Model rwd-medium-text, region us-west-2. We use the JS SDK with streaming client:
```js
const stream = client.stream.create({ model: 'rwd-medium-text' });
stream.on('data', chunk => console.log('chunk', chunk));
// then client closes when it sees \"[DONE]\" but here it never arrives
```
No client error logged, connection just drops.

ops-bot: Alert: gateway:stream-early-eof spike 5xx-rate +23% over last 15m (hosts: gw-12, gw-17)

carlos_eng: @amanda_support tagging in eng — initial hypothesis: client is half-closing then NAT/proxy tears the socket and our gateway sees a FIN without trailer => heuristics mark as 5xx. Can you confirm if client sends a final empty chunk or relies on connection close?

amanda_support: customer says they rely on connection close when they detect end-of-stream.

kevin_sre: If clients don't emit final chunked trailer or `\r\n0\r\n\r\n`, middle proxies sometimes send RST/FIN early. Our current billing pipeline treats connection-terminated streams with no final chunk as server error in gateway layer. That's probably the miscount.

customer_acme: Is there a workaround? Users are being billed for failed responses.

carlos_eng: Short-term: add client-side explicit final chunk before close. Example curl streaming pattern:
```bash
echo -ne "data: partial\n"
# after done
echo -ne "\r\n0\r\n\r\n" > /dev/tcp/host/port
```
Long-term: we'll tweak gateway logic to distinguish client-initiated halfclose vs server 5xx for chunked requests.

amanda_support: I've opened an internal billing ticket (BILL-9321) and flagged for credit review. Also requesting a sample pcap from the customer.

customer_acme: I'll grab a pcap and a reproducible minimal repro. Thanks. :pray:

kevin_sre: Filed infra task: INFRA-4147 to update EOF heuristics and add metric to surface RFC-compliant chunked closes. If you can repro reliably, include headers + raw bytes.

amanda_support: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open until customer sends pcap. :thumbsup:
